spacing_and_layout.strategy: Generous spacing, architectural density for dashboard, bento grid for landing.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-none or rounded-sm (max 4px) for sharp technical feel

surfaces_and_micro_themes.landing_features: Tracing Beam/Neon Glow: 1px border with subtle box-shadow glow using #c6e08a or #a8c6e0
surfaces_and_micro_themes.generator_panel: Retro-Futurism: Deep black bg #0a1118 with neon green #c6e08a borders/text for the generated password

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark navy (#0f1b2d, #0a1118), lime green (#c6e08a), and sky blue (#a8c6e0) color palette. Do NOT introduce purples, pinks, or generic tech blues.
Use Orbitron for the 'KRIPT' logo and major headings, Outfit for subheadings, and IBM Plex Sans for body text.
Implement the UI in Spanish as requested.
Build the dashboard using a 'Control Room' dense grid, ensuring every interactive element has a data-testid.
Use standard Shadcn components but override their border-radii to be 'rounded-none' or 'rounded-sm' (max 4px) to fit the technical/cyber aesthetic.
Do not use generic Shadcn Cards for everything; use flat backgrounds with 1px borders (Grid Borders style).
For the Password Generator, make the generated password highly visible using 'IBM Plex Mono' in lime green on a deep black background.
Always apply a dark overlay (e.g., bg-[#0a1118]/80) over background images to ensure text readability.
Avoid generic 'Bootstrap' symmetry in the landing page; use asymmetry and bento grids.
